filter_result.description: Analysis and potential reformatting of a question to address directness issues or inconsistencies.

reasoning.description: Detailed explanation of why the question does or doesn't need reformatting, including specific issues found.

needs_reformatting.description: Whether the question has issues with directness or inconsistencies that require reformatting.

improvements_made.description: Explanation of the specific improvements to be made in the reformatted question. Only provided if needs_reformatting is true else empty.

reformatted_question.description: The reformatted question that addresses the identified issues. Only provided if needs_reformatting is true else empty.
